selected_script.angle: Struggling to clean dusty narrow gaps beside laundry appliances, solved by manually bending and extending the electrostatic gap duster.
selected_script.hook: Frustrated home user tries to force a rigid broom into a narrow gap next to a washing machine, getting it stuck.

usage_steps_used: Twist connector to unlock and extend the stainless steel telescopic handle to desired length, then twist to lock firmly
Bend the flat microfiber duster head manually to match the required cleaning angle or gap contour
Slide the flat duster head under furniture gaps or wipe across high wall surfaces to trap dust electrostatically

video_001_part_01.narrative: A home user struggles with a dusty washing machine gap using a standard broom. They switch to the extendable, bendable duster, adjusting it for use.
video_001_part_01.visuals: 0-3s: An adult home user tries to slide a thick rigid household broom into a narrow gap between a washing machine and a wall, looking frustrated as it gets stuck and fails to clean. 3-6s: The user holds the Replacement Gap Duster with a flat grey microfiber sleeve, light blue plastic connector, and metallic silver pole. They twist the light blue plastic lock on the handle, extend the telescopic pole axially, and twist to lock. 6-10s: The user manually bends the flat grey duster head core to match the narrow gap contour, then slides it smoothly parallel to the floor into the narrow washing machine gap.

video_001_part_02.narrative: The user sweeps under low cabinets and high walls, trapping dust electrostatically, followed by a final CTA.
video_001_part_02.visuals: 0-4s: The user slides the flat duster head under a low-clearance laundry room cabinet, sweeping back and forth parallel to the floor. 4-8s: The user wipes the duster head across high laundry room wall corners to trap dust, then pulls it out showing accumulated lint electrostatically attached to the grey plush microfiber. 8-10s: Neutral product placement shot next to the laundry machine. On-screen text: 'Keep every gap dust-free easily.'
